question: The cultivation of high value crops such as vegetables, fruits and flowers is called ________.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Horticulture.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Horticulture is** the branch of plant agriculture using with garden crops, usually fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants.
 
• Horticultural crops involve **fruits, vegetables, medicinal, aromatic, and ornamental plants**.
 
• Examples of horticulture involve the following: **landscaping**. **gardening.**
 
• **Marigowda **is also famous as **Father of Horticulture in India.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3232b39ec0607f5d1fc85b029193c1d784dd1f805b7b8329be78a7f6115ece4.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The artificial reproduction, rearing, and transplantation of fish** is known as pisciculture.
 
• ​Apiculture is **the operation of keeping bees and also the manufacturing of honey and beeswax**. 
 
• Sericulture is **the growing of silkworms to produce silk**.
